items.title: 좋아하는 장르
items.question: You indicated that you like to go to the movies. What kinds of movies do you like to watch? Why do you like that genre?
script: I watch various kinds of movies, but my favorite genre is **science fiction**.
What I like about them is their creative stories and impressive visuals.
